verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only generic marketing statements and community sentiment about Vue's ergonomics, TypeScript support, and general popularity, but nothing about async server-rendered components, data fetching patterns (e.g., Suspense, async setup, server components), or passing server data to client components. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of async component data fetching, SSR-specific APIs (Suspense, defineAsyncComponent), or Nuxt/vue server-components integration demonstrating this exact workflow.
